answer: A new agent must wander through a probation epoch, completing verifiable tasks while peers watch for cloned behavior; only reputation slot-matched work earns reputation. Sybil resistance can be enforced by requiring each agent to stake a bonded deposit whose value is slashed on proved duplication, so forging identities costs real capital. Like a falcon striking a single target, the slashing event burns the stake to an ember, making mass fake accounts economically irrational and leaving genuine contributors standing. In practice, sa0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
